name: Koby
effect:
Your {SWORD} type Characters can attack Characters on the turn in which they are played.
[Once Per Turn] If your {Navy} type Character with 7000 base power or less would be removed from the field by your opponent's effect, you may place 3 cards from your trash at the bottom of your deck in any order instead.

official_faq.question: If 2 of my {Navy} type Characters with 7000 base power or less would be removed from the field by the [On Play] effect of my opponent's "OP01-094 Kaido", can I use this Leader's [Once Per Turn] effect to prevent both Characters from being K.O.'d? If so, do I place 3 cards or 6 cards from my trash at the bottom of my deck?
official_faq.answer: Yes, you can. The amount of cards you place at the bottom of your deck from your trash will be 3 regardless of how many Characters would be removed from your field.

official_faq.question: If I have 2 or less cards in my trash and my {Navy} type Character with 7000 base power or less would be removed from the field, can I use this Leader's [Once Per Turn] effect to prevent my Characters from being removed from the field?

2 of my {Navy} type Characters with 7000 base power or less, [Character A] and [Character B], were K.O.'d at the same time when I had 2 cards in my trash. In this case, can I first trash [Character A], then use this Leader's [Once Per Turn] effect to prevent [Character B] from being removed from the field?
